import os
import sys
from multiprocessing import Pool


def run_chunk(args):
    n, c = args
    p = list(range(c, n)) + list(range(c))
    q = [0] * n
    s = list(range(n))
    sign = 1
    max_flips = 0
    checksum = 0

    while True:
        q0 = p[0]
        if q0 != 0:
            if p[q0] == 0:
                flips = 1
            else:
                q[:] = p
                flips = 1
                while True:
                    qq = q[q0]
                    if qq == 0:
                        break
                    q[q0] = q0
                    if q0 >= 3:
                        i = 1
                        j = q0 - 1
                        while i < j:
                            q[i], q[j] = q[j], q[i]
                            i += 1
                            j -= 1
                    q0 = qq
                    flips += 1

            if flips > max_flips:
                max_flips = flips
            checksum += flips if sign == 1 else -flips

        if sign == 1:
            p[0], p[1] = p[1], p[0]
            sign = -1
        else:
            p[1], p[2] = p[2], p[1]
            sign = 1
            for i in range(2, n):
                sx = s[i]
                if sx != 0:
                    s[i] = sx - 1
                    break
                if i == n - 1:
                    return checksum, max_flips
                s[i] = i
                t = p[0]
                p[0 : i + 1] = p[1 : i + 2]
                p[i + 1] = t

    n = int(sys.argv[1])

    if n == 1:
        print(0)
        print("Pfannkuchen(1) = 0")
        return
    if n == 2:
        print(-1)
        print("Pfannkuchen(2) = 1")
        return

    tasks = [(n, c) for c in range(n)]

    if cpu_count > 1 and n >= 7:
        with Pool(processes=cpu_count) as pool:
            results = pool.map(run_chunk, tasks)
    else:
